work_packages.name: Operating Model & Service Design
work_packages.objective: Define the target service portfolio, the organisation that delivers it and the footprint it runs from, so that process and technology design have a fixed frame.

sub_streams.name: Service Catalogue & SLAs
sub_streams.objective: A costed catalogue of 46 services with agreed SLAs and a KPI baseline.

sub_streams.name: Organisation & Role Design
sub_streams.objective: Target structure, role profiles and span-of-control model for 640 GBS roles.

sub_streams.name: Location & Footprint Strategy
sub_streams.objective: Confirm the two-hub-plus-nearshore footprint and secure the site build-out.

work_packages.name: Process Standardisation
work_packages.objective: Move four end-to-end finance processes onto a single global standard with a documented control framework, so the hubs inherit one way of working, not five.

sub_streams.name: Record to Report
sub_streams.objective: One global close calendar, standard journal taxonomy and a rebuilt control set.

sub_streams.name: Purchase to Pay
sub_streams.objective: Single P2P flow with touchless invoice processing and one supplier master.

sub_streams.name: Order to Cash
sub_streams.objective: Standard billing, collections and cash application with one dunning policy.

sub_streams.name: Master Data & Controls
sub_streams.objective: One governed master data model for vendor, customer and chart of accounts.

work_packages.name: Technology & Automation
work_packages.objective: Deliver the platform the standard processes run on: one ERP template, a workflow and automation layer, and reporting that the service reviews can be run from.

sub_streams.name: ERP Template Alignment
sub_streams.objective: Collapse four regional ERP variants onto one global template.

sub_streams.name: Workflow & Intelligent Automation
sub_streams.objective: Automate 38 candidate steps across P2P, O2C and R2R with a governed pipeline.

sub_streams.name: Reporting & Analytics
sub_streams.objective: One performance layer: SLA, KPI and cost-to-serve reporting for the service reviews.

work_packages.name: Transition & Change
work_packages.objective: Move the work to the hubs without losing it: structured knowledge transfer in three waves, with the change and training effort sized to the same waves.

sub_streams.name: Knowledge Transfer & Migration
sub_streams.objective: Three migration waves covering 640 roles, each gated on a stability review.

sub_streams.name: Change, Comms & Training
sub_streams.objective: Readiness for 640 movers and 1,200 retained users, measured not assumed.

criteria: Baseline scope and benefit case approved

criteria: ERP template build complete and unit tested

stage_gates.name: Go-live readiness
criteria: Integration and user acceptance testing signed off

stage_gates.name: Hypercare exit

SLAs met for two consecutive service review cycles
Benefit run-rate tracking within 10% of the case

raid.title: P2P country tax variants exceed design assumption
raid.description: Italy, Spain and Poland e-invoicing variants each need bespoke configuration that the design assumed would be template-standard, putting the Gate 3 build date at risk.
raid.mitigation: Two Group Tax analysts released to P2P through October; conditional Gate 3 pass proposed for P2P only.

raid.title: Works council consultation extends the selection window
raid.description: German and Dutch consultation opened two weeks late. Any further slip compresses selection and appointment into the Gate 4 window with no float.
raid.mitigation: Weekly tracking with Legal & Employee Relations; parallel-running Dutch selection under review.

raid.title: Hub trainer capacity constrains overlapping migration waves
raid.description: Waves 2 and 3 now overlap by seven weeks. Hub trainer capacity supports one wave at a time without contract support.
raid.mitigation: Contract trainer capacity costed and put to the steering committee; resequencing wave 3 held as fallback.

raid.title: Legacy vendor data quality below the migration threshold
raid.description: 23% of legacy vendor records fail the new validation rules against an assumed 8%, threatening the WP4 cleansing cut-off.
raid.mitigation: Three additional data stewards requested; automated duplicate detection brought forward.

raid.title: Retention of critical knowledge holders through selection
raid.description: 34 incumbents hold undocumented process knowledge and sit in scope for selection. Attrition before knowledge transfer would be unrecoverable within the plan.
raid.mitigation: Retention framework drafted with HR; knowledge capture prioritised for the 34 named roles.

raid.title: Single global cutover weekend leaves no fallback window
raid.description: The agreed cutover approach concentrates all five regions into one weekend, with rollback feasible only in the first 18 hours.
raid.mitigation: Two full cutover rehearsals scheduled; go / no-go checkpoint set at hour 12.

raid.title: Wave 1 automation delivery four items behind plan
raid.description: 11 of 18 wave 1 automations are in pre-production against a plan of 15, because four P2P automations were re-scoped when the P2P design reopened.
raid.mitigation: Four automations proposed for wave 2; wave 1 benefit shortfall of 0.8 FTE accepted.

raid.title: Intercompany invoice routing design reopened
raid.description: Two design decisions closed at Gate 2 were reopened after the tax variant finding, leaving the intercompany routing rules unconfirmed.
raid.mitigation: Decision paper to the Global Process Owner forum on 2026-09-04.

raid.title: Three training modules require rework
raid.description: Three of 22 curriculum modules were built against the superseded P2P design and must be rebuilt before the wave 1 delivery window.
raid.mitigation: Rework scheduled into the September sprint; no impact on the delivery start date.

raid.title: 128 incumbents not yet mapped to target roles
raid.description: 512 of 640 incumbents are mapped. The unmapped population is concentrated in the two regions where consultation has not yet opened.
raid.mitigation: Regional HR leads to complete mapping ahead of consultation opening in each region.

raid.title: Group Tax capacity for P2P country variants
raid.description: P2P build completion depends on two Group Tax analysts being available through October. Group Tax is concurrently supporting the statutory reporting change.
raid.mitigation: Steering committee decision requested; Group Tax lead has confirmed availability in principle.

raid.title: Krakow fit-out completion gates wave 1 onboarding
raid.description: Wave 1 hub onboarding cannot start before the Krakow fit-out hands over. Handover is planned for 2026-10-16 against a wave 1 need date of 2026-10-26.
raid.mitigation: Weekly contractor review; temporary space secured as a two-week buffer.

raid.title: Master data cleansing cut-off gates migration validation
raid.description: Migration validation cannot begin until the cleansed vendor and customer masters are frozen on 2026-10-09.
raid.mitigation: Cut-off protected by the additional steward request; partial-freeze option assessed as fallback.

raid.title: Information Security review of the automation platform
raid.description: Wave 2 automation build depends on the platform-level security review, which is scheduled behind two higher-priority Group IT reviews.
raid.mitigation: Review slot confirmed for 2026-09-22; evidence pack submitted early.

raid.title: Regional finance teams available for UAT
raid.description: Assumes regional finance teams provide 240 person-days for user acceptance testing in the October to December window, alongside the year-end close.
raid.mitigation: UAT scheduled around the close calendar; commitment to be confirmed at the September steering committee.

raid.title: Desk ratio of 1.4 holds for both hubs
raid.description: The footprint business case assumes a 1.4 desk ratio. A lower ratio would require additional Krakow floor space at a cost of EUR 0.6m.
raid.mitigation: Ratio validated against the hybrid working policy; reviewed again at wave 2 planning.

raid.title: No statutory reporting changes land in scope during build
raid.description: Assumes no new statutory reporting requirement enters scope before Gate 4. One EU proposal is under consultation with a possible 2027 effective date.
raid.mitigation: Group Finance Policy monitors the consultation and reports monthly to the programme board.

raid.title: Benefit baseline holds at the FY26 cost base
raid.description: Benefit measurement assumes the FY26 cost base as the baseline. A mid-year reorganisation in two regions could move the baseline.
raid.mitigation: Baseline frozen with Group Finance; any restatement to be handled as a change request.
